testcase.name: Scenario: Decline replacing an existing part during first save: tmp/obk-save2/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:232:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Decline replacing an existing part during first save ✔ Given the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the current folder contains an existing part file ✔ When the user selects the existing part file ✔ And the user chooses Save ✔ Then a confirmation identifies the existing file and asks whether to replace it ✔ And the confirmation offers Yes and No ✔ And the Save As dialog remains behind the confirmation ✔ When the user chooses No ✔ Then the confirmation closes ✔ And Save As remains open with the existing file name displayed ✔ When the user cancels Save As ✔ Then the new unsaved part remains active
